verdict.rationale: Warp documents API keys that let the Oz CLI, cloud agents, and self-hosted workers authenticate without human interaction, so it does issue credentials meant for agents. Nothing in the evidence shows those keys can be scoped or restricted to least privilege. Agent profiles limit what an agent can do (file access, commands, MCP usage, directories), but that is an adjacent agent-permission control, not credential scoping. missing for 10: documented per-key scopes or permission restrictions, key expiry/rotation or revocation controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
